name: Linecast
author: Jordan Thomas (JMThomas00)
description: Companion to the Omarchy weather widget, backed by the linecast CLI (https://github.com/ashuttl/linecast): one popup with all six of linecast's views — Weather, Radar, Sunshine, Moon, Tides, and Maps — replayed live from its own terminal output, with real keyboard and mouse input forwarded back into it, not reimplemented or simulated.

barWidget.description: Current temperature in the bar; click for linecast's Weather, Radar, Sunshine, Moon, Tides, and Maps, all live and interactive in one popup
